units.source_text: 我从口袋里取出照片一看，不由得“啊”了一声，被那遗容吸引住了。

en.t: I took the photograph out of my pocket and looked at it, and before I knew it I let out an "ah," drawn in by the face of the deceased.

units.source_text: 照片拍得极好，就像酣睡的样子，而且充满了死的安详气氛。

en.t: The photograph was beautifully taken; she looked as if she were sleeping soundly, and it was filled with the peaceful atmosphere of death.
